The roots are the two fifth-grid cosines, giving all four unordered designs; fifth-root cancellation makes C4=-1/2 too. value.rationale: The objective is the least diagonal Fisher information among three or four independent modal channels, a natural robust sensing design with two physical sites. The theorem gives the complete global continuous optimization and all equality configurations, a tight four-mode equal-information design, and a 25% sharp improvement over repeated sites for three modes. It is not arbitrary parameter substitution or a known-table evaluation: the common three/four-mode optimum needs a nontrivial global Chebyshev exclusion argument. No generalization to raw sensor trajectories is asserted.
